text: After 30 years, the green space at 1555 Danforth at Coxwell officially became a city park. It is now formally a park with an official name - Coxwell Common. For all these years it has been a beautiful respite and community gathering space along the busy Danforth. It also hosts the Courtyard Farmers’ Market each week. Unlike most other green spaces, it was built with a full irrigation system that leads to a circle in the middle of the park which was to be a water feature. Since the beginning the circle has only ever had a tree with some plantings. A water feature would improve the overall enjoyment of the park as one of only of two green spaces on the Danforth between Broadview and Victoria Park. The planting beds would benefit from renewal and additional planting to improve biodiversity, visual appeal, climate resilience, and overall park quality. Now that it is formally parks property,…

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1.
